edges.reason: Constructor assigns ceoAddress = msg.sender.
Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
sell uses msg.sender through the isOwnerOf modifier and as token owner.
buy receives the NFT and emits events with msg.sender.
withdraw is restricted to msg.sender == ceoAddress.
changeCeo is restricted to msg.sender == ceoAddress.
cancelBussiness is restricted to msg.sender == ceoAddress.
removePrice checks ownership against msg.sender and refunds msg.sender.
setLimitFee is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setLimitFeeAll is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
sell reads and updates Games[_game].tokenPrice for the token.
buy reads price and owner from Games[_game].tokenPrice.
resetPrice clears the stored Price struct in Games.
setPrice writes the Price struct into Games.
calPrice reads stored price and fee from Games.
calFee reads Games[_game].Fee.
cancelBussinessByGame reads Games[_game].tokenIdSale.
setLimitFee writes Fee and limitFee into Games.
setLimitFeeAll writes Fee and limitFee into Games.
calFee divides by Percen.
revenue iterates over arrGames.
cancelBussiness iterates over arrGames.
setPrice pushes the game into arrGames if not present.
sell calls setPrice to persist the new listing.
sell calls calPrice to compute the required payment.
sell calls calFee to compute the fee.
sell calls resetPrice when the stored owner is stale.
sell uses isOwnerOf which performs an external erc721Address.ownerOf call.
removePrice uses isOwnerOf which performs an external erc721Address.ownerOf call.
removePrice calls resetPrice after refunding.
buy calls resetPrice after transferring value.
withdraw forwards to _withdraw.
cancelBussiness calls cancelBussinessByGame per game.
cancelBussiness calls _withdraw with the full balance.
cancelBussinessByGame calls cancelBussinessByGameId per token.
cancelBussinessByGameId calls resetPrice.
resetPrice calls _burnArrayTokenIdSale.
calPrice calls calFee.
buy performs an external ERC721 transferFrom before resetPrice clears state.
buy sends native value to the seller before resetPrice clears state.
removePrice transfers the stored fee to msg.sender before resetPrice.
_withdraw performs a native transfer to msg.sender.
cancelBussinessByGameId transfers stored fee to tokenOwner before reset.
cancelBussinessByGameId performs an external ERC721 transfer before reset.
_game parameter selects the Games entry used by sell.
_tokenId parameter indexes Games[_game].tokenPrice in sell.
_Price parameter is the new listing price written by sell.
tokenId parameter indexes the price entry used by buy.
amount parameter is forwarded from withdraw.
amount parameter controls the native transfer in _withdraw.
_address parameter becomes the new ceoAddress.
_Fee array values are written to Games[_game].Fee.
_limitFee array values are written to Games[_game].limitFee.
erc721Address local holds the external contract instance used for transferFrom in buy.
Need local receives the value returned by calPrice.
fee local receives the value returned by calFee.
newOwner parameter becomes the new owner in transferOwnership.
